messages:
sophie: Heads-up: Havenly wants a short perf POC next Tue. Target: 120 qps sustained, ~256 token requests, p99 <300ms, multi-region failover. They prefer Private but will consider Dedicated. Also attached a KMS/security questionnaire. Need a runbook + quick hosted vs dedicated cost delta by EOD. cc @raj @jules

raj: Got it. Which model? batching allowed? KV cache ok? These change GPU packing a lot.

sophie: They requested redwood-ggml-large-q4. Batching ok if we can hold p99 <300ms. They're worried about per-request KMS decrypts.

jules: Run outline: 10m warm (20 qps) -> ramp to 120 over 20m -> 4h soak at 120 -> 30m spike to 240 -> region failover test. Trace sampling 1%. Include both q4 and fp16 variants.

matt: Ops notes: set timeout 6s, per-worker concurrency 8, enable KV prefix caching, pre-warm model, capture kms-unwrap spans. I'll schedule and run the job, add headers x-kms-cache and x-cache-hit.

raj: Quick sizing: dedicated ~6 A100-equivalent GPUs for safe headroom with batching; 8 if they want aggressive headroom. Quant q4 uses less mem but more latency variance at long seqs.

finance-bot: Ballpark cost stub: hosted (q4) ~ $600/day for the test window; dedicated (pro-rated) ~ $220/day + KMS & egress. If HSM-backed KMS required, add ~20% overhead.

security-bot: Questionnaire logged: https://redwood-internal/q/HVN-2026-KMS. Short explainer: we use envelope encryption; DEKs are unwrapped at load/rotation and cached in runtime (default TTL 6h). KMS unwrap is not performed per inference in Private/Dedicated. We'll produce a one-pager diagram.

sophie: Perfect. Can someone post the final runbook, k6 snippet, and the short KMS explainer by 17:00 PT? I need to send to the customer.

jules: Will post runbook + KMS one-pager by 17:00 PT.

matt: I'll attach k6 and fortio snippets and schedule the run for 2026-04-07T15:00:00Z (run id hvn-1832).
